vector.description: Host conformance positive control (§3.3, §3.5): a well-behaved verifier returns a schema-valid `allow` carrying an explicit `"kind":"zk"` at exit 0. §3.5 states that a `zk`-class verifier MAY omit the field and that "emitting `"kind":"zk"` explicitly is equivalent for a revision-aware host"; §3.3 permits `kind` on either verdict. The host MUST relay `allow` and MUST NOT treat the explicit default class as an unrecognized `kind` (the §7.2 fail-closed path applies only to values outside the {classical, zk, external} enum). Catches a host that whitelists only the two non-default classes, or that accepts `zk` solely by absence of the field.
